baseline_models.focus_anchor: The addressed object remains كُمْ across نبدل أمثالكم and ننشئكم, while في ما لا تعلمون withholds the resulting mode.
baseline_models.mechanism: Changing an image without necessarily replacing its substance, followed by fresh origination, permits continuity of the addressed identity through discontinuity of its present embodiment.

activation_trace.role: Change of a thing's image while its substance remains makes the first verb a transformation of embodiment.
The pictured exemplar supplies the form or representation that can be changed.
Fresh bringing-into-being supplies the second operation after alteration of form.
Negated cognitive disclosure keeps the new condition genuinely unspecified.

changed_reading.before: One present body is simply removed and another is supplied.
changed_reading.after: The present likeness can be reconfigured while the same addressed 'you' is freshly brought into an unknown mode.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نبدل أمثالكم combines substitution with the plural 'your counterparts,' then distinguishes that act from ننشئكم.
baseline_models.mechanism: One person or group can be displaced by analogous successors, while the conjunction opens a second horizon in which the displaced addressees themselves are originated anew.

activation_trace.role: One thing taking another's place supplies literal succession.
Similarity and counterpart status define the successors as analogues rather than identical returns.
Fresh creation prevents collective replacement from exhausting the promise made to 'you.'

changed_reading.before: The verse speaks only of each individual's later recreation.
changed_reading.after: It can hold collective succession by counterparts and the addressees' own later origination together without collapsing them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ننشئكم can carry growth and elevation as well as initial creation, and it is followed by في ما.
baseline_models.mechanism: Origination may be staged maturation or rising into a condition, so the unknown concerns an unfolding order rather than only an instantaneous manufacture.

activation_trace.role: The growth and upbringing of the young supplies a developmental trajectory.
Rising and elevation give that trajectory a movement into another level or condition.
The withheld knowledge leaves the stages and destination outside present experience.

changed_reading.before: ننشئكم denotes a single completed act of recreation.
changed_reading.after: It may denote being raised or grown into an unknown condition whose process is as undisclosed as its result.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured creation, form-bearing reproductive material, and apportioned death turn 'likenesses' into reproducible configurations: a present instantiation can end without exhausting the agency that measured it.

activation_trace.role: The represented form is the focus-ayah anchor for a configuration that can be instantiated again.
Fresh origination realizes the measured configuration beyond its current instance.
Measuring and proportioning creation supplies a reproducible ordering operation.
Reproductive material from which form is measured supplies an observed small-origin-to-shaped-being transition.
Deliberate apportioning makes death part of the same ordered agency rather than a failure of creation.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from reproductive material (56:58), through disputed creative agency (56:59), to apportioned death (56:60) and then replacement plus origination (56:61).
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured creation, form-bearing reproductive material, and planned death; I infer that the same measuring agency can instantiate the addressed identity beyond death. Alternatively, the examples prove power without specifying continuity, and أمثالكم may mean successor people.

changed_reading.before: Replacement is an arbitrary exchange of one shape for another.
changed_reading.after: Replacement can be a measured re-instantiation: the current realization ends, while its ordering and addressed identity remain available to fresh origination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Death is deliberately distributed among a plural community and cannot escape its administrator; substitution by counterparts therefore reads as regulated cohort turnover, alongside rather than instead of later origination.

activation_trace.role: Taking another's place supplies the succession operation.
Counterpart likeness identifies the incoming cohort as analogous to those displaced.
Planned apportionment turns mortality into an administered process.
A relation joining plural parties makes death a distributed event within the group.
Loss of life supplies the removals through which cohort succession operates.
Failure to get beyond the pursuer makes the replacement process unoutstrippable.

structural_cues: The repeated plural suffixes and بينكم place death and replacement at community scale before ننشئكم returns the claim to the addressees.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies apportioned death among a plural group, unavoidable agency, and counterpart substitution; I infer population-level turnover. Alternatively, every plural may still refer only to the same individuals at resurrection.

changed_reading.before: أمثالكم names only the addressees' replacement bodies.
changed_reading.after: It can also name counterpart cohorts installed through apportioned mortality, while the following verb preserves a distinct promise concerning the addressees themselves.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah opposes present ignorance to already-known first origination and commands recollection, relocating uncertainty from whether origination occurs to the mode into which it occurs.

activation_trace.role: Negated knowledge marks the undisclosed part of the focus claim.
Origination is the operation whose future mode remains unknown.
Affirmed knowledge immediately limits what the preceding negation can deny.
The same creation image labels the known first instance and establishes a precedent.
Priority marks present creation as the first case rather than the only conceivable case.
Recollection converts the known first case into evidence for the undisclosed one.

structural_cues: لا تعلمون in 56:61 is answered immediately by ولقد علمتم in 56:62, with ن ش ء repeated across the boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an unknown future setting and a known first origination; I infer that ignorance attaches to modality, not to agency or possibility. Alternatively, 56:62 may offer only a general proof and leave every detail of 56:61 open.

changed_reading.before: The addressees have no basis for knowing whether another origination is possible.
changed_reading.after: They know an origination has already occurred and are asked to reason from it, but cannot project its familiar mode onto the future one.

context_deltas.mechanism: Tilling supplies prepared material, but growth belongs to another agency and the same crop can instead be rendered fragments; this makes origination a directed developmental process whose outcome is not controlled by its visible preparers.

activation_trace.role: Growth and upbringing anchor the focus verb to staged development.
Casting seed and cultivating supply the preparatory human action.
Germination and growth supply the emergent process denied to the human cultivator.
Effective will selects which potential state becomes actual.
Rendering a thing into a condition supplies the directional state-change.
Dry matter broken into fragments supplies the live alternative to growth.

structural_cues: The أأنتم... أم نحن agency question in 56:64 repeats the creation contrast of 56:59, then 56:65 presents a counterfactual state-change.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sowing, nonhuman causation of growth, and the alternative of fragmentation; I map that process onto ننشئكم as an analogy for directed emergence. Alternatively, the crop is only a separate providential proof and says nothing about the mechanics of human origination.

changed_reading.before: Future origination is best imagined as immediate fabrication of a finished body.
changed_reading.after: It may be a directed emergence from prepared but powerless material, with development rather than visible input determining the resulting form.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby transformation of viable growth into fragments, binding loss, and deprivation prevents the unspecified future condition from being filled automatically with positive value.

activation_trace.role: Alteration of condition anchors the possibility that transformation can change valence as well as form.
Negated knowledge leaves the future condition unevaluated.
Crushing a mature crop demonstrates a sovereign transformation with destructive value.
Inescapably attached loss supplies the affective and judicial consequence of that transformation.
Missing the desired good names the resulting state as deprivation.

structural_cues: The unknown claim is followed within four ayat by a will-conditioned destructive transformation and a two-step lament of loss and deprivation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an unspecified future and a neighboring negative state-change; I infer that the focus ayah itself does not license an automatically favorable outcome. Alternatively, crop loss concerns present gratitude only and does not qualify the future creation.

changed_reading.before: Being created in an unknown condition implicitly means elevation to a better condition.
changed_reading.after: The condition is sovereignly determined but valence-open in this ayah; unfamiliarity may include exposure to deprivation or judgment, not only enhancement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same pronominally continuous water can be rendered bitter without ceasing to be the referenced water; this gives a concrete local analogue for continuity of 'you' through replacement of a present likeness.

activation_trace.role: Image-change without necessary substance replacement anchors identity-preserving transformation.
The represented form identifies what can vary while reference persists.
Ordinary water supplies the stable referent before the proposed alteration.
Rendering the same thing into another condition supplies the transformation operator.
Salty bitterness supplies the radically altered property carried by the continuing referent.

structural_cues: The object introduced as الماء in 56:68 remains the object of أنزلتموه in 56:69 and جعلناه in 56:70 despite its counterfactual property-change.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pronominal continuity across a proposed change from potable water to bitter water; I use that as a local analogy for personal reference across altered likeness. Alternatively, the water example is independent and replacement in 56:61 remains literal substitution.

changed_reading.before: A changed likeness implies a numerically different occupant.
changed_reading.after: Reference can persist across radical state-change, so the continuing كُمْ need not be identified with continuity of its current likeness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fire latent in a firestick emerges as an unlike manifest state from a tree whose origination is claimed by the same verb as the focus ayah, and the result is explicitly made a reminder; unknown origination can therefore involve concealed capacity becoming a qualitatively discontinuous manifestation.

activation_trace.role: Fresh origination anchors the hidden-to-manifest analogy in the focus ayah.
Transformation of appearance allows the manifested result to differ sharply from its source.
The burning fire names the manifest outcome.
A fire concealed in the firestick and drawn out supplies the latent-to-manifest transition.
Repeated origination attributes the carrier tree and its capacity to the same creating agency.
The ordinary trunked tree supplies a material source unlike the fire that issues from it.
A thing made to remind explicitly licenses the preceding fire process as analogical evidence.

structural_cues: The sequence asks about kindled fire (56:71), repeats إنشاء over its tree (56:72), and calls the result تذكرة (56:73).
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies latent fire, a created tree, repeated ن ش ء, and an explicit reminder; I infer that hidden-to-manifest emergence can model unknown human origination. Alternatively, the reminder concerns divine provision or final fire without encoding a transformation mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The unknown creation is merely a new object externally substituted for the old one.
changed_reading.after: It may be the manifestation of a presently concealed capacity, continuous in source yet as qualitatively unlike the present form as fire is unlike its tree.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because أمثال normally activates likeness rather than exemplary mutilation; it remains root-anchored through the م ث ل punishment branch and gains local support from crushing and deprivation. Downstream prose should present it only as a faint punitive overtone, not as the lexical sense required by the construction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The plural أمثالكم can carry a remote echo of persons or forms made exemplary under transformation.

activation_trace.role: Punitive exemplarity contributes the possibility that a transformed form serves as a warning.
Alteration of image supplies the bodily or visible transformation on which the warning would depend.
Crushing into fragments supplies a nearby punitive material image.
Deprivation supplies the warning's negative consequence.

changed_reading.before: The unknown transformation is semantically neutral.
changed_reading.after: At the far edge of the root inventory, transformed likenesses may also carry exemplary or admonitory force.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it shifts علم from cognition to marks and uses the non-dominant و س م mapping of اسم; both are packet-resolved and the focus remains لا تعلمون. Downstream prose should qualify it as a semiotic metaphor: the future condition may lack familiar identifying signs, while the closing divine name remains the orienting sign.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: لا تعلمون can be heard against the root's image of a mark that identifies and guides.

activation_trace.role: An identifying and guiding mark recasts unknownness as absence of presently readable signs.
Fresh origination supplies the new order whose signs need not match current ones.
A visible identifying mark, reached through the packet's split mapping for اسم, supplies an orienting sign at the sequence's close.
Transcendent disassociation cautions against forcing present creaturely categories onto the unknown order.

changed_reading.before: لا تعلمون means only that factual information is missing.
changed_reading.after: It may also suggest an order not indexed by familiar marks of identity, requiring orientation by the named creator rather than projection from present signs.

strongest_changes: The first-origination echo in 56:62 confines ignorance chiefly to future mode rather than creative possibility.
Measured generation and the water counterfactual support continuity of the addressed identity through discontinuity of present form.
Crop growth and latent fire turn origination from static replacement into directed emergence from an unpromising or unlike source.
Crushing, attached loss, and deprivation keep the unspecified future condition valence-open.
summary.what_was_special: The tightest activation came from the water and fire sequences: water retains reference across radical property-change, while fire emerges from a created tree and is explicitly made a reminder. Together they separate continuity of 'you' from continuity of the present likeness without pretending to describe the unknown result.
remaining_uncertainties: أمثالكم may designate successor persons, embodied forms, or likeness-patterns; the focus construction does not force one.
في ما may leave an unknown state, domain, process, or created configuration unspecified.
The agricultural, water, and fire passages may prove agency without mapping the mechanism of human origination.
The developmental and sign-system activations depend on form-distant branches and should remain exploratory.
